description: React component for an autosizing textarea with dynamic height and width recalculations, including scrollbar visibility control.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Type definition for component props, including optional event handlers and styling options.

methods.name: recalculateHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the textarea height based on content and triggers onHeightChange callback.

methods.name: recalculateWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the reference div and triggers onWidthChange callback.

methods.name: setTextareaRef
methods.description: Sets the ref for the textarea element, supporting both callback and object refs.
